import jsonl_changed as m

# Basic + whitespace skip + CRLF + final line without newline
assert m.parse_jsonl('{"a":1}\n\n  \n{"b":2}\r\n{"c":3}') == [{"a":1}, {"b":2}, {"c":3}]

# Unicode
assert m.parse_jsonl('{"name":"café"}\n"日本語"') == [{"name":"café"}, "日本語"]

        pass

    try:
        m.parse_jsonl(bad)
        raise AssertionError("expected ValueError")
    except ValueError:
        pass

# Empty / whitespace only
assert m.parse_jsonl('') == []
assert m.parse_jsonl('\n  \n\r\n') == []

print("all checks passed")
PY
